decisions.reason: As the flagship new product line with its own page, close to the core offer and with prospects still unfolding, this option is cheap to keep open and central to the firm's digital direction.
The education institute builds on the firm's existing training resources and customer base, so it costs little to maintain, and one year of results is too early to judge its value.
Remote screen sharing support is a low-cost addition that complements the firm's customer support operations, so there is no reason to abandon it while it serves existing clients.
